system.description: ( Specification Required) This specialty enables a person to read and write texts in the selected language. It can be purchased multiple times, They can add +2 to their Skill Value per level when trying to learn about the chosen race’s history. The specialty focuses on a single culture: Stormlanders, Mittlanders, Viranns, Wildfolks, Dwarves, and Elves.
system.summary: Allows reading and writing in the chosen tongue once that foreign language has been learned.
